name: Printers (PRINTER-MIB / Host Resources)
_comment: Applies to every device: the counter OIDs return nothing on non-printers, and the scanner only emits a pagecounters block when at least one answers. Identity fields list the PRINTER-MIB OID first and fall back to the base ENTITY-MIB one after a '|', because a profile that applies everywhere would otherwise blank the serial of every non-printer it touched. Supply levels are deliberately absent from this profile: prtMarkerSuppliesTable is read directly by the collector, because the toner and drum levels are the whole reason anyone watches a printer and they should not depend on someone having installed the right profile row.
